paragraphs.en: Hi, I'm Dr. Aarthi Vemana, co-director of the Pediatric and Adolescent Sleep Center.
paragraphs.zh: 我是阿尔蒂·韦马纳医生，儿科与青少年睡眠中心的联合主任。

paragraphs.en: The COVID-19 pandemic has had a huge impact on everyone's daily lives.
paragraphs.zh: 新冠肺炎疫情对每个人的日常生活都产生了巨大的影响。

paragraphs.en: Now, we do have more time at home to focus on sleep, but sleep is really difficult in stressful periods.
paragraphs.zh: 现在，我们确实有更多的时间待在家里专注于睡眠，但在压力大的时期，入睡真的很难。

paragraphs.en: So, I wanted to take a few moments to talk to you guys about having a good sleep schedule and how to maintain that sleep schedule during the quarantine period. Start off by having a good bedtime routine.
paragraphs.zh: 我想花点时间跟大家聊聊保持良好作息，以及在隔离期间如何维持这种作息。首先要养成一个良好的睡前习惯。

paragraphs.en: And that bedtime routine doesn't have to be anything complicated, but it should be the same few steps done in the same order at the same time every night.
paragraphs.zh: 睡前安排不必复杂，但每晚都应该在同一时间按照相同的顺序完成相同的几个步骤。

paragraphs.en: This helps your brain realize that it's time to wind down to go to sleep.
paragraphs.zh: 这会帮助你的大脑意识到是时候放松下来睡觉了。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, make sure that you're waking up around the same time every day and keep yourself on a schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天早上，确保你每天大约在同一时间起床，并让自己保持规律作息。

paragraphs.en: That schedule should include exercise and that exercise is best done during the daytime, if possible.
paragraphs.zh: 该时间表应该包括锻炼，如果可能的话，最好在白天进行锻炼。

paragraphs.en: At night, make sure that you're putting your screens away about an hour before you go to bed.
paragraphs.zh: 晚上，确保在睡前大约一小时就把电子设备收起来。

paragraphs.en: This helps to minimize your blue light exposure and that's important because blue light can trick your brain into thinking that it's daylight outside.
paragraphs.zh: 这有助于减少你接触蓝光的时间，这很重要，因为蓝光会欺骗你的大脑，让你以为外面还是白天。

paragraphs.en: But more importantly during these stressful COVID-19 times, the content of what we're looking at on the screens can be very stressful and can be very anxiety provoking for young ones.
paragraphs.zh: 但更重要的是，在充满压力的新冠疫情期间，我们在屏幕上看到的内容可能非常令人紧张，可能会让年轻人非常焦虑。

paragraphs.en: So, instead of using screens, spend some time together as a family.
paragraphs.zh: 与其使用电子设备，不如一家人一起共度一些时光。

paragraphs.en: Talk about all the good things that have happened during the day and focus on the positive. This will help to distress everyone's brains right before bedtime.
paragraphs.zh: 聊聊白天发生的所有好事，关注积极的方面。这将有助于在就寝前让大脑放松。

paragraphs.en: If you're still having trouble, reading or guided relaxation is a great option to help focus your brain on something that's not related to COVID-19.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你仍然有困扰，阅读或引导式放松是个不错的选择，能帮助你的大脑专注于与新冠疫情无关的事情。

paragraphs.en: I hope everyone stays home and that they stay healthy.
paragraphs.zh: 希望每个人都待在家里，保持健康。
